description: Defines data structures and parsing logic for 'TalkDirective', including parsing JSON-based directives from text, with classes for directives and parse results, and a parser with static helper methods.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Represents a set of optional speech synthesis parameters such as voice ID, speed, style, etc.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Holds parsing outcome including the directive, the text stripped of directive JSON, and unknown keys.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a text string to extract a TalkDirective if present, returning the parse result.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract string values from JSON dictionary for a list of keys.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract Double values from JSON dictionary for a list of keys.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract Int values from JSON dictionary for a list of keys.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract Bool values from JSON dictionary for a list of keys.
